subject: [hw] DONE D01
body:
D01 done (FACTS.md + the three censuses). Host-tested only; no phone, no publish, no commit.

Last line of bash gpu/hwcodec/facts/run_tests.sh:
    N2TEST D01 PASS 32/32
(runtime 60-90 s; the same run prints "reachable instructions: 309511" and "A32 instructions: 0")

Delivered:
- gpu/hwcodec/FACTS.md: 8 sections (hardware, phone results from runs/q10hw1, imports, instruction census, VCU ABI, AP<->VCU message flow, iOS side, open questions), 96 table rows, every row statement + evidence + [V]/[I] + reporter. Seeded from PLAN 1-2 and STATUS, merged K02 (SPM/bus protection), V03 (relocations), V12 (Thumb-2), V14/V10 questions.
- facts/imports.py: exactly 149 external imports, grouped into n2shim_string 27, heap 8, thread 50, stdio 27, android 35, data 2; posted per table to V30/V32/V33/V34.
- facts/census.py: recursive walk from every FUNC symbol and .ARM.exidx entry; 309511 reachable instructions, ALL Thumb (A32 = 0). Function-range coverage: vpud 94.7%, vcodecdrv 88.3%, utility 78.1%, oal 100.1%, vpud_vcodec 67.0% (raw .text 79/73/69/70/57%). Per-class mnemonic lists posted to V10/V11/V12/V14/V15/V16/V17/V18/V19/V20.
- facts/vcu_usage.py + facts/vcu_usage.md: /dev/vcu opened by venc_vcodec_msg_handler (0x11bd6, 0x11bf6) and vdec_codec_msg_handler (0xc528); /dev/vpu also opened by the decoder (0xc540); VCU_SET_OBJECT 0x40587600, PA_ALLOCATION 0xc0207606, PA_FREE 0xc0207607, GCE_SET_CMD_FLUSH 0x40207608, GCE_WAIT_CALLBACK 0x40107609; GET_OBJECT (0xc058760a) only via a runtime value; VDEC register mmap offset 0x16000000 len 0x40000. Posted to V40.

Not done (full list in dsh-state/workers/D01/STATUS.md): census coverage below 90% for four objects (computed branches + embedded data + a 4-call fill budget; every undecodable address is listed); 785 undecodable instructions and 5 unclassified mnemonics; libvcodecdrv.so not scanned for its register mmap; class split is mnemonic-table based.

Files: gpu/hwcodec/FACTS.md, gpu/hwcodec/facts/{imports.py,census.py,vcu_usage.py,vcu_usage.md,run_tests.sh}, gpu/hwcodec/dsh-state/workers/D01/STATUS.md. Staying available for review findings.
